description: This file defines an interface and template classes for iterators within the Thunder::Core namespace, including standard, map, and lockable iterators, with methods for traversal and access.

classes.name: IIterator
classes.description: Abstract interface for iterator classes, providing methods for traversal, validation, and indexing.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: Template class implementing IIterator for generic container iteration with forward/backward traversal and index management.

classes.name: IteratorMapType
classes.description: Template class implementing IIterator for std::map containers, providing key/value access and iteration.

classes.name: LockableIteratorType
classes.description: Template class extending IteratorType with lock management for thread-safe iteration.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is currently at a valid position.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the container.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns a reference to the current element.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current element in a map container.
